assumptions.reason: The owner's bill does not show the tax rate area, so the rate cannot be read off the county table. 1.18% sits inside the verified county range of 1.126% to 1.241%.

assumptions.item: Fixed charges on each tax bill
assumptions.value: about $830 (A) and $1,100 (B) a year, rising with inflation
assumptions.reason: The part of each bill that the percentage rate does not explain. Fixed charges do not grow when the assessed value is reset.

assumptions.reason: Follows the adjustment rule as written: one year's index change, applied every other February.

assumptions.value: $6,500 a month in 2026, rising 3% a year

Scenario.

assumptions.item: Rent for the third unit of Property B when the family moves out
assumptions.reason: Set equal to the average of the two rented units. A new tenancy may start at any rent, then rises with the capped increase.

assumptions.item: Rent growth for sitting tenants in Property B
assumptions.reason: 60% of the assumed 2.5% inflation, which is the published formula. The current allowed increase is 1.6%.

assumptions.item: Share of value that is building, not land
assumptions.reason: Scenario. Only the building is depreciated. The assessor's land and improvement split was not supplied.

assumptions.value: $9,300 a year (A) and $10,800 a year (B) in 2026, rising with inflation
assumptions.reason: Scenario: 1.0% of building value for A and 1.5% for B. The owner states that A costs less to maintain than B.
5.0% scenario allowance for agents, escrow, title and preparation, plus the verified 0.11% county transfer tax.

assumptions.item: Tax on rental income and on rental losses used
assumptions.reason: Scenario household: 24% federal plus 9.3% California. Losses are assumed usable against Property B's rental income.

assumptions.item: Tax on a large one-time gain
assumptions.reason: 20% federal, 3.8% net investment income tax and 12.3% California. Depreciation taken is taxed at 41.1%.

assumptions.item: Tax on dividends and on Treasury interest
assumptions.reason: 15% + 3.8% + 9.3% on dividends. Treasury interest is assumed free of state tax: that exemption was not re-verified here.

assumptions.item: Home-sale exclusion if the family lives in A
assumptions.reason: Joint return. It is $250,000 on a single return.
